environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Express service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a private subnet (no IGW route). The ALB target group performs health checks on /health. The ALB listener has a default fixed-response 403 action, with forwarding rules conditioned on source IP matching a prefix list (pl-0a8e2c4f91b3d7e60) containing only 10.0.0.0/8 and 172.16.0.0/12 ranges. The VPC has no NAT gateway egress path configured, and the only ingress to the private subnet is via VPC peering from the monitoring VPC (10.200.0.0/16) and the corporate VPN CIDR (172.16.50.0/24). The ECS task role has no network-facing permissions. Security group sg-0f4a2b8c9d1e3f567 allows inbound only from sg-0abc123def456 (the ALB security group) on port 3000, and the ALB security group sg-0abc123def456 allows inbound only from the prefix list pl-0a8e2c4f91b3d7e60.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB, internal, private subnet only
config.subnet: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway
